value.author: sceneGroup
value.layerInfo: Blur a Shape outwards from a central point with customisable attenuation.

origin: Set the centre point of the blur where 0,0 is the centre of the Shape.
amount: Set the distance/strength of the blur.
attenuationMultiplier: Multiply the blur based on the distance from the 'Origin'. A lower value will create a harder transition.
